channel.title: ShopNow 047 — Checked, not hyped.
channel.description: We do not pretend to have tested these. We tell you exactly what to look for at the listing, in about ninety seconds.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you actually compare?
item.description: The fork in the road is not brand or price. It is shape - a basket you shake or a door you open. Here is what each shape costs you, and the four questions that settle it.
item.author: The ShopNow 047 desk

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts are a volume, and a volume is not a dinner. Eight checks that turn a number in a title into a decision you can defend at the counter.
item.author: The ShopNow 047 desk

item.title: Cleanup and counter space: the trade-offs nobody puts in the headline
item.description: The two costs that decide whether an air fryer gets used daily or lives in a cupboard. A measured way to price both before you order.
item.author: The ShopNow 047 desk

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Eight functions in a product title can be eight real modes or one fan with marketing attached. A short interrogation you can run at the listing.
item.author: The ShopNow 047 desk

item.title: Why a probe, not a timer, is how you know chicken is done
item.description: Three numbers worth memorising, why an air fryer's basket makes them harder to guess, and what a wireless probe is actually for.
item.author: The ShopNow 047 desk

item.title: How to read an Amazon listing in 90 seconds without getting sold
item.description: A listing is a marketing document with a data table stapled to it. Here is the order to read it in, what to skip, and the four fields that tell you the most.
item.author: The ShopNow 047 desk
